title: Shellshock
overview:
Justice Is Just That!

A raging, graffiti-covered future is upon us and you've just joined a ragtag group of highly trained commandos, committed to combating terrorism and corruption worldwide. You're gonna do it with the help of a fully armored, state-of-the-art M-13 Predator Battletank!

- Battle across some of the most intense 3D terrain in real-time, full color, explosive, first-person perspective!
- Fight the good fight listening to the original, hardcore hip-hop beats of Bar None... a.k.a. William Floyd of the San Francisco 49ers!
- 25 terrifying missions in the most politically volatile regions in the world!
- Explosive game play progression with unfolding story-lines and upgradeable weaponry!
